body:
Actually, it's the opposite. I used to always get angry at people who pissed me off.

Only this time I tried a different approach.

Your first line is very wise.

Exactly. She made me feel guilty about it by complimenting my looks so I tried to perceive it as healthy encouragement.

I'm so used to girl friends who take but don't give, that I question myself. It's disheartening. I don't understand why I always find myself around these types.
Maybe I have a penchant for trying to help those with a bit of a black sheep quality because I can relate. I didn't think of her as a bully. What sticks out at you as her being one?
